title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
Overview

Job Title: Email Marketing Manager

Working Hours: Monday - Friday 9 AM to 5 PM EST

Salary: $2,500-$3,000/month (DOE)

Location: LATAM (Remote)

About The Company

Our client is a family-owned leader in the global fragrance and beauty market. They are hiring for their growing, discount fragrance e-commerce arm, making luxury fragrances accessible.

About The Role

You won’t just “send emails.” You’ll own the strategy and execution for our entire email program — from deliverability to design, from segmentation to revenue attribution. You’ll be responsible for identifying problems before they hurt performance, designing tests, and rolling out strategies that both drive sales and protect profitability.

This role requires end-to-end ownership : you’ll ideate, build, and launch campaigns and flows, monitor performance, and report insights — all while thinking like a CMO about how email drives the broader business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Ownership
    • Set and execute the email & SMS marketing roadmap, aligning with company goals and seasonal priorities (BFCM, holidays, new product launches).
    • Develop a campaign calendar segmented by audience tier (L30D Engaged, VIPs, Winback, etc.), balancing promotions, education, and trust-building.
    • Partner with leadership to ensure offers, bundles, and campaigns align with 30% margin discipline.
  • Flows & Campaigns
    • Audit, rebuild, and scale high-impact flows: Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Browse Abandon, Post-Purchase, Winback, Loyalty.
    • Implement A/B testing frameworks across subject lines, offers, CTA destinations, and content blocks.
    • Ensure post-click alignment: every email deep-links to the right PDP, collection, or curated landing page.
  • Segmentation & Deliverability
    • Own list health: define engagement tiers (L30D/L60D/L180D), build suppression & sunset rules, and protect sender reputation.
    • Continuously monitor deliverability metrics (spam, bounce, placement) and take proactive corrective actions.
    • Personalize email content through dynamic product blocks, brand preference segmentation, and purchase behavior triggers.
  • Creative & Copy
    • Lead the creative direction for email & SMS: subject lines, messaging, CTA clarity, and mobile-first design.
    • Incorporate UGC, reviews, brand storytelling, and seasonal guides into the content mix.
    • Work with design support to ensure consistent branding, while prioritizing clarity and conversion.
  • Data & Reporting
    • Report weekly on RPR (Revenue per Recipient), Placed Order Rate, and Revenue Attribution.
    • Spot declining trends early (e.g., clicks dropping, unsub rising) and propose fixes proactively.
    • Quantify the impact of tests and new initiatives with clear revenue lift projections.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in lifecycle/email marketing, ideally for D2C or e-commerce brands.
  • Deep experience with Klaviyo (flows, segments, deliverability, revenue attribution).
  • Proven track record of growing email as a top revenue channel (ideally >25–30% of total revenue).
  • Strong copywriting instincts and ability to brief/design persuasive email assets.
  • Comfortable with data analysis (segmentation logic, RPR, campaign/flow attribution).
  • Hands-on executor who can own strategy and implementation without heavy oversight.
  • Experience integrating SMS into lifecycle strategy.
  • Bonus: knowledge of CRO, loyalty programs, or e-commerce retention marketing.

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Marketing and Sales

Industries

  • Staffing and Recruiting

title: Mechanical & Plumbing BIM Specialist
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Mechanical & Plumbing BIM Specialist role at ENG .

The Role

The BIM Specialist role covers modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on background and project scope (specific zones or entire buildings). Responsibilities include ensuring high-quality modeling (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC) with autonomy in self-management. A BIM Specialist helps clients by detecting conflicts during the initial information review, modeling, and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements

  • Excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written. Candidates must be able to engage in fluent conversations with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered.
  • Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction. This includes process piping, ductwork, sheet metal, mechanical equipment (pumps, AHUs, RTUs, chillers, boilers), and plumbing (domestic water, sanitary drainage, gray water, stormwater, medical gases, compressed air lines, pumps, heaters, and hangers).
  • Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto considered but Navisworks preferred); knowledge of BIM coordination, clash reports, QAQC, and model accuracy.
  • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelor’s degree (architects could be considered if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades).

Desirable/Additional requirements

Specific requirements vary by position and service. Experience with LOD 400 and projects based in the US , or constructability knowledge related to that country, is a huge differential . Other desirable items include:

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve , SysQue , Fabrication Parts ).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM.
  • On-site/field experience .
  • Ability to produce detailed models, including real-world fittings and connection types .

Please note: if you don’t have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to be considered. Also, please ensure your English level meets the requirement.

About ENG

Who we are: ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we are the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 500 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

Work arrangements & Benefits

  • Work from Anywhere: Flexibility to work remotely or from a coworking space.
  • Paid time off: Flexible paid time off when you need it.
  • Wellness & Culture: Freedom and responsibility culture, healthy snack allowances, team celebrations.
  • Continuous Learning: Programs to develop technical and soft skills.
  • Work Equipment: Equipment provided to create a productive workspace.
  • Tech & Office Allowances: One-time allowances to upgrade devices and home office setup.
  • Monthly Internet Allowance: Monthly allowance for internet and related expenses.
  • Compensation: Highly competitive package, in USD, with fixed and variable components.
  • Join us and grow in a flexible, innovative environment!
  • Additional note: Compensation will be in USD, commensurate with experience.

Before you apply, ensure your CV is in English; otherwise the application cannot be considered.

title: Software Maintenance Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

Location: This is a remote role; we have teams in all time zones.

Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This role involves working in a dynamic Linux-based infrastructure and applications environment, spanning all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications used by large enterprise customers.

This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical\'s Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
• We’re looking for individuals with hands-on startup and SaaS experience who thrive in fast-paced, product-driven environments.
  • While we value diverse backgrounds, applicants whose experience is exclusively within consulting firms may not be the best fit for this role.
  • Please submit your resume in English to ensure a smooth review process.

---

This is an opportunity to build something truly big. You will have a direct impact on the industry and the way people travel, connect, and discover the world. That is the kind of work you can expect at Enso Connect.

What we do

Enso Connect is a guest experience platform for vacation rentals and boutique hotels that seamlessly plugs into property management systems to personalize and monetize interactions throughout the entire guest journey. From AI-driven messaging and contactless check-in to upsells and verification, we are the "Zapier of hospitality" - connecting all the tools you already love while increasing profit per guest.

We are a well-funded startup with strong product-market fit and excellent sales momentum. We are expanding rapidly and need to scale our engineering team. Our current tech team is around 12 people. We operate as a true meritocracy where the best ideas win regardless of seniority. We have an energetic culture that moves fast. Every engineer has a voice in technical and product decisions.

You will be joining our engineering team to help build this mission-critical system that processes thousands of bookings daily for hospitality businesses worldwide. This is a full-time remote position (38-40 hrs/week) that requires high autonomy and self-direction, with significant ownership over your work and direct connection to business impact and clients. We require overlap of at least 3 hours with EST business hours (9 AM - 5 PM EST). On rare occasions, system outages may require attention outside of regular business hours.

Who You Are

As a full stack software developer, you will be instrumental in the architecture, design, development, delivery and support of key features and integrations. You will work closely with our development team throughout the entire development lifecycle to solve diverse business & technical challenges.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Gathering requirements & feedback from stakeholders (sales, client success, product) to address business & technical challenges
  • Architecting & scoping solutions that strike the right balance between quality and velocity
  • Build and maintain scalable features & improvements end to end, including testing & deployment
  • Managing your tasks & communicating changes in your own timelines pro-actively
  • Monitoring your work post-deploy to ensure a high level of quality and positive feedback from users
  • Collaborate on architecture decisions for a clean and easy to maintain system
  • Participating in design sessions and code reviews with peers to elevate the quality of engineering across the organization

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience building and maintaining web applications, ideally with a strong backend focus.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, event-driven systems, and RESTful APIs.
  • Comfortable designing and implementing features end-to-end, including architecture, infrastructure, frontend/backend logic, testing, and deployment.
  • Experience working in a cloud-native environment, ideally with AWS Lambda, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, OpenSearch, and serverless Framework.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD workflows, testing (unit, integration), and monitoring tools like DataDog or CloudWatch.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You enjoy working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and support teams.
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Cursor, etc) to accelerate development and improve engineering workflows.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience creating and modifying end to end integrations using API specifications and UX guidelines.
  • Serverless infrastructure experience, specifically AWS & FaaS
  • Experience working at startups / Proptech
  • Experience working directly with the customer / end user to triage problems.
  • Bonus if you are available for occasional in-person work in downtown Toronto, but you would be required to have a overlap of at least 3 hours with EST business hours.

Why Us?

  • We are a dynamic and innovative company that is dedicated to making a positive impact in the hospitality industry. Our team is made up of passionate and dedicated individuals who are committed to driving change and pushing boundaries. We offer a collaborative and dynamic work environment that encourages creativity and growth.
  • Our company is known for its industry-leading technology
  • By joining us you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, be part of a culture that values your contributions and have access to ample resources and training to help you achieve your professional goals.

Benefits and Perks

  • Unlimited Vacation : As long as key deliverables are met, you have unlimited time off
  • Employee Stock Options : Option for ESOP participation as part of compensation plan
  • Remote-First Culture : Fully remote with flexible hours (within EST overlap requirements)
  • Direct Impact : Your work directly affects business outcomes and client success
  • Growth Opportunities : Rapid company growth means expanded responsibilities and career advancement

Enso Connect is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal-opportunity employer. Enso Connect does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status.

Overview

Join to apply for the Editor, Marketing role at Darkroom .

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

As a Video Editor on Darkroom’s internal Marketing Team, you’ll shape the visual storytelling behind our brand. You’ll transform raw content into engaging, high-impact videos for platforms like Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn. This is a fast-moving, creative, and collaborative role for someone with sharp instincts, strong technical skills, and a passion for crafting content that connects with audiences.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

  • Edit and produce standout content across short-form (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and long-form (YouTube, webinars).
  • Create native video formats optimized for IG, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and X, including repurposed edits and cutdowns.
  • Build scroll-stopping hooks, apply text overlays, closed captions, sound design, and motion graphics that support performance.
  • Turn voice notes, podcasts, webinars and interviews into polished, platform-native video content.
  • Surface and extract the most compelling moments from raw footage: podcast soundbites, behind-the-scenes gems, founder tangents, interviews, etc.
  • Collaborate with the Video Lead on edits, structure, and narrative framing.
  • Organize, tag, and manage footage to create a systemized pipeline for recurring content formats.
  • Understand performance data and collaborate with the marketing team to refine editing strategies based on what drives reach, engagement, and conversion.
  • Test hooks, variations and formats to optimize output over time.
  • Stay ahead of editing trends and platform algorithm shifts.

Production Excellence

  • Apply finishing touches: color correction, transitions, graphics, and text effects that align with the Darkroom brand language.
  • Deliver content in multiple aspect ratios and formats for cross-platform distribution.
  • Maintain high audio fidelity, visual clarity, and consistent branding across deliverables.
  • Proactively troubleshoot creative or technical challenges and recommend solutions.
  • Support post-production for Darkroom’s podcast and event recordings.
  • Add intros/outros, audio enhancements, and accessible subtitles.

You’re a Great Fit If You:

  • Have 3-4+ years of experience editing content for social-first brands, creators, or agencies.
  • Know your way around Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and have working knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and motion graphics.
  • Have a sharp eye for storytelling, pacing, and rhythm, and you know how to build content that keeps attention.
  • Understand editing for performance, not just aesthetics. You know what performs on TikTok vs. YouTube Shorts vs. LinkedIn.
  • Are fluent in optimizing content across multiple aspect ratios and formats.
  • Can own your edit from concept to final export while staying collaborative, communicative, and open to feedback.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments where no two days (or edits) are the same.
  • Are organized, meticulous, and always ready with a plan B (or C).

Bonus Points If You:

  • Have experience editing founder-led content or personal brand material.
  • Have worked on performance-driven or growth marketing creative.
  • Use AI tools (Descript, Runway, etc.) for cutdowns, transcription, or speeding up your workflow.

What It\'s Like To Work At Darkroom

We\'re building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays per year.
  • Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Equity incentives and profit-sharing opportunities.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

Ser MJVer é estar em um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar.

O esforço é de todos nós, e as conquistas também. Porque ser um MJVer é bem mais do que ser um colaborador: é sobre fazer parte.

Somos colaborativos, ágeis, plurais, criativos e inovadores. Somos MJV!

Experiência com Design Thinking: Forte habilidade em aplicar os princípios do Design Thinking, incluindo empatia, pesquisa, ideação e prototipação;

Mentalidade Humanista: Capacidade de ir além de ferramentas e processos, atuando em ações que comuniquem o propósito da transformação e mudem a mentalidade e os valores das pessoas;

Colaboração e Comunicação: Experiência em co-criação com líderes e colaboradores, e na colaboração para engajamento e prontidão para a mudança;

Vale Refeição;

Plano de saúde e odontológico - Amil;

️ Grupos de idiomas;

People Mobility: damos uma forcinha para pessoas que tem interesse e disponibilidade de atuar em projetos desafiadores em outros estados e países;

Ações de treinamento: palestras, fóruns, trocas e conversas de conhecimentos relativos ao nosso negócio. Estamos em constante conexão para aprender mais e juntos;

Parcerias: quer desconto? Temos um grupo no Workplace onde divulgamos parcerias com instituições de ensino, escolas de idiomas, academias, restaurantes, produtos e outros serviços;

Co-criação: conectamos talentos para gerar soluções completas. Colaboração está no nosso sangue.

Sobre a MJV

A MJV é mais do que uma simples consultoria de tecnologia e inovação . Somos um grupo de mentes diversas, visionárias e determinadas, combinando design, dados e uma mentalidade ágil para oferecer soluções completas, que vão desde a concepção até a implementação de TI.

Nosso legado começou há mais de 25 anos , com o propósito de ajudar empresas a prosperar em suas jornadas de transformação. A MJV é composta por um vasto grupo de pessoas que acreditam no trabalho colaborativo. Aplicamos o Design Thinking , as Metodologias Ágeis e a Sustentabilidade em todos os nossos projetos. A transformação digital também é um dos nossos pilares. Nossa equipe multidisciplinar é formada por designers, engenheiros, publicitários, antropólogos, cientistas de dados, desenvolvedores, empreendedores e muito mais. title: Consultant, Global Pricing & Access (Remote)
description:
Overview

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are EVERSANA.

Team and role context

THE TEAM: Our Global Pricing & Market Access (PMA) team at Navlin is a dynamic, international group that combines deep inhouse expertise with real-time intelligence—from pricing and HTA updates to regulatory news—via Navlin’s industry-benchmark platform. Empowered by advanced price-management software and launch-sequence simulation tools (navlin.com), we deliver strategic, well-informed recommendations on pricing and access for our clients.

Composed of top talent from across Europe, our multicultural team blends local market nuance with creative synergy. We embrace a flexible remote-working model—fully supported by robust IT tools—and maintain satellite offices in London, Berlin, and Milan, freely accessible to all team members. Our team is rapidly expanding with consistent year-on-year growth.

Our project portfolio includes critical initiatives such as, among others, launch sequencing and pricing strategies for ATMPs and orphan drugs, indication-expansion planning, LOE strategy, forecasting, and asset due diligence—spanning Europe and global markets. While a dedicated team oversees U.S. initiatives, we lead global efforts across Europe, APAC, and LATAM. We also collaborate closely with EVERSANA’s internal functions—commercial, HEOR, medical affairs, and others—in global launch execution projects, ensuring PMA remains central to global launch execution of new assets.

The Position

The Consultant, Global Pricing and Market Access position will be involved in delivering client consultancy projects and helping to manage project-related analytics, data and tools available through our industry platform Navlin or dedicated secondary and primary research. The Consultant will ensure that tasks within client projects or internal activities are delivered to schedule, while maintaining the highest level of quality and value expectations.

In addition, the Consultant will also contribute to business development through the development of proposals. Activities will be executed under the guidance of an Engagement Manager, mainly remotely due to remote team composition. In some cities with physical EVERSANA offices, the Consultant is fully able to use the company office, as well.

The role is home office based, (full-time position), located in Italy, Remote.

Our consultants are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of the project team. These results are achieved by:

  • Designing and executing client analyses and deliverables

  • Applying high attention to quality and detail with strong written and spoken English
  • Applying excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills, and ability to present information in compelling and creative ways (story telling through data, insights, effective slides)
  • Occasional management of more junior resources, such as associate consultants or interns
  • Working effectively in a remote environment, often with limited face-to-face contact with team members and client counterparts
  • However, working under supervision of a more senior member of the team, usually with daily alignments on operative tasks.

Minimum Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • B.S./B.A in relevant field of study required (life sciences or economic/managerial sciences, medical engineering).
  • 2-4 years of pharmaceutical, medical/health industry-related experience and/or 2-4 years management consulting experience
  • Understanding of life sciences business practices and the issues clients face in specific segments of responsibility
  • Strong conceptual, analytic and problem-solving skills
  • Strong knowledge of the market research development process
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative market research skills
  • Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook
  • Ability to structure and use large amounts of data and other types of information from multiple sources to complete a final analysis of a business question/situations and make recommendations
  • Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and work on several projects and multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Demonstrated self-awareness and accountability
  • Ability to lead and own personal projects
  • Ability to establish credibility in front of clients at companies
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately up to 10% of annual worktime, mainly for off-site company events)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MS, MPH).
  • Background in International Pricing and Market Access, analytics and modelling/forecasting would be a plus to effectively lead Global Pricing and Market Access projects for key clients.
  • 2+ years of management consulting experience.

LMI is seeking a Strategic Communications & Change Management Specialist to support a governance, risk, and compliance transformation at a national agency. title: Grid Services Strategic Technical Product Lead
description:
Overview

Ever since we started in 2007, Sunrun has been at the forefront of connecting people to the cleanest energy on Earth. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. Sunrun is on a mission to change how the world interacts with energy, prioritizing employee development, well-being, and safety. Our vertically integrated model provides opportunities for growth across the energy lifecycle from sale through installation and beyond.

A renewable energy transformation is underway, with rooftop solar and rechargeable batteries expanding as the grid evolves. Sunrun aims to lead in home electrification and Distributed Energy Resources through Virtual Power Plants. We are seeking skilled individuals who share an entrepreneurial, customer-first mindset to help cement Sunrun as a leader in this revolution.

Sunrun is the country’s largest residential distributed power plant operator with over 130k batteries and 650 MWs enrolled in programs in summer 2025. Join our team at this pivotal moment in the industry.

Position Summary

POSITION SUMMARY

As a Strategic Technical Product Lead you will be responsible for linking our Grid Services products and Data Integration services. You will partner with the tech team to vision and oversee a best-in-class data platform for operating Virtual Power Plants consisting of multiple battery vendors and other distributed energy resource technologies. You will lead the build of a new technical product requiring an organized data warehouse for storing, validating, organizing, aggregating, and serving time-based energy data. The data infrastructure should standardize observability and monitoring.

You will understand core business objectives and define the future state technology platform vision. You will define business requirements for the backend data pipeline, schema, and API strategy to manage DPPs through a centralized command platform with a front-end product interface for internal and external users. This includes API connectivity to battery and DERMS vendors, full stack web app development, data processing and normalization (e.g. telemetry), and data visualization (e.g. map and display of all batteries).

You will act as Sunrun’s public-facing technology expert and assist the business development and policy teams in partner meetings, conferences, and regulatory proceedings.   • Collaborate with Engineering leaders, business stakeholders, and others to drive outcomes.

  • Work cross-functionally with program, pricing, policy, operations, product management, and business development to prototype and iterate on product and process; develop and manage team efficiencies and standards.

  • Stay up-to-date on the competitive landscape and changes in the industry.

Target Achievements

  • Within your first month, familiarize yourself with operations, current battery control strategy and tools, policy developments, and data architecture; ask critical questions and develop a point of view.

  • By the end of month two, build business requirements for a new technical product, working with operations and engineers to drive product implementation.

  • By month three and beyond, contribute to business development as a subject matter expert on platform capabilities and independently lead product development.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience; Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience required.

  • Experience leading data architecture/infrastructure products.

  • Experience with energy monitoring and data platforms (e.g., VPPs, DERMS or similar).

  • Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, Salesforce, AWS, and related products.

  • Full stack experience preferred, including backend and data skills (Python, Django, PostgreSQL, REST API, React, JavaScript, AWS, and/or Google Cloud).

  • Experience optimizing cloud strategies and infrastructures.

  • Experience with Observability tools and frameworks (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, CloudWatch).

title: Client Operations Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Client Operations Manager role at Chore

As the Operations Program Manager / Chief of Staff (Client Accounts), you’ll run back-office ops (HR, Finance, Compliance) for multiple startups—owning delivery, triaging edge cases, and building scalable processes.

About Us

Chore exists to make every startup and SMB in the world successful. We believe that the more successful startups, the better a world we’ll all experience.

Operations are foundational yet most companies chronically underinvest in them to their detriment. We build and maintain their back-office operations so that they can focus on their differentiating superpowers.

We work behind the scenes to help our clients win. We like efficiency. We geek out on checklists. We are transparent with each other and our clients. We are professional, inclusive, and autonomous and our goal is to provide a culture that fosters long-term success, is reputation & trust-based, fun, and pushes each of us to always learn.

We are looking for proactive, detail-oriented individuals interested in joining as a "Chore CEO" (what we call our operation program managers). Lead multi-workstream back-office programs (HR/Finance/Compliance) for startups; unblock teams and leaders, and deliver outcomes across a client portfolio.

You are the main conduit through which all our client's back-office operations run. You are their project manager and leader. You are the person they trust to keep things running so they can focus on their product and sales.

A Chore CEO serves as a fractional Chief of Staff/Chief Operating Officer — working with multiple startup founders / CEOs to project manage key corporate matters. These responsibilities are often tactical, but as you build trusted relationships with the CEOs of these world-changing startups, you will also become their strategic partner. In short, you are the unsung hero and critical foundation to their startup. Successful project manager operations leads get it done, figure it out, proactively get ahead of problems, and communicate every step.

Some examples of the work we do

  • The operations team is sometimes the dumping ground for things that don't go anywhere else. While others are bothered by that, we revel in it. We get it done when no one else can.
  • Use judgment and thoughtfulness — “can you work with our accountant to get taxes filed?” or “can you get this NDA out to a customer and coordinate if there are any issues?”
  • Research and problem-solving for back-office edge cases.
  • Be smart enough and skilled enough to jump from a finance question to an HR question to a vendor question.
  • We handle the complex unknowns.
  • Strategic work — e.g., “how should I think about compensation and benchmarks for my company?” We’ve seen this organically happen at times when OPs have built a trusted relationship with clients.

Qualifications/Skills

  • 5+ years of startup business experience that includes interfacing with clients or external parties is required.
  • 2+ years experience in at least two of the following: Project management, Product management, Customer Success, Client Operations, HR, Finance, Legal/Law/Attorney, or Compliance.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and excellent ability to context switch.
  • Great communication skills: this includes not only an ability to talk on a call but much more so, write down every step and communicate the value of that step, effectively.
  • Ability to say "no" in a way that doesn’t feel like a "no" to the other party.
  • You love building deep, trusting relationships with dynamic founders across many industries.
  • Are a total geek for better processes, more standardization, and reinventing things just enough to make them more efficient. You enjoy improving every day. You know what Kaizen means and the fact we care about it excites you.
  • Checking items off of your work list, while also considering ‘how can I do this process more efficiently,’ brings a smile to your face. There is always more to do for clients and you thrive on getting things done while simultaneously knowing that you are helping to move these amazing startups forward.
  • People who have a deep dedication to client service and doing right by our stakeholders.
  • Seeing delight on a client's face brings delight to your day.
  • Ability to focus in stressful situations and almost automatically prioritize.
  • Openness to giving and receiving feedback.
  • You don't mind doing the unsexy part of running a startup - i.e. dealing with regulators (including waiting on hold forever for them to pick up), managing employee offboarding, and basically doing the "startup plumber" work.
  • If you believe you deserve to only work on "sexy things" then this isn’t the role for you. We live in the unsexy but critical.
  • You want to join a passionate, fun and kind team for the long-term (2+ years). While this role might be a stepping stone and we celebrate our team member’s growth, if you apply, our assumption is that you’d prefer a job where you can see yourself for several years.

Compensation

  • Base compensation, starting compensation is $40,000 USD per year but we expect most teammates, once ramped and with bonus, will earn around $52,000 USD or more per year.
  • Every team member receives equity in Chore, which is variable based on level. Since we're building for the long-term, we offer equity on the high side.
  • Note: we do not negotiate as we believe it is biased against various groups and creates poor dynamics. Instead, we pay and promote based on performance and meeting clearly defined metrics.

The Best Parts

  • ️ We are fully remote, do not require any travel and have somewhat flexible hours! The expectation is that all Chore CEOs work standard US hours from 9-5pm.
  • We’re good people who work well together while solving critical problems for awesome startups.
  • WFH stipend up to $250/month (office setup, coffees, co-working space, etc).
  • Why is "executive" coaching only valuable for executives? We think that's stupid. Optional coaching 2x/mo.
  • Only four ~30-minute team meetings/week.
  • Support from a team of other experts and teamwork to complete your work.

Additional Notes

  • There will be five 15-60 minute interviews via Google Meet, one of which is a Q&A with another Chore CEO to vet the role for you, too!
  • To help set you up for the success, half of the questions are provided for the 1st interview
  • We will ask for up to 4 former (or current) manager references.

If you want us to consider your application, you must apply to the role via the form.

We like fun and making some magic. Join us. You'll learn more and, we expect, have more fun than any other role you've ever had.

Company overview

About the Company

Sagan represents a U.S.-based short-term rental company that specializes in optimizing vacation rental operations. The company values accuracy, analytical thinking, and proactive communication in managing a growing rental portfolio.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Rental Revenue Manager to lead pricing and demand optimization for a portfolio of short-term rentals. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with revenue management experience in hospitality or vacation rentals. Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute pricing and revenue strategies to maximize occupancy and revenue.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years’ experience in revenue management, ideally in vacation rentals, hospitality, or property management.

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to work independently.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in short-term rental portfolio management.
  • Familiarity with OTA platforms (Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com).
  • Knowledge of both pricing strategy and distribution management.

Funções em cada frente de atuação

  • Delegação, briefing e hand-off de tarefas para o time de designers;

Microindústria de sidras e bebidas fermentadas com sede em Curitiba.

caembrasil.com.br | instagram.com / caembrasil

Join TeamViewer, the leader in remote connectivity software. We harness the potential of cutting-edge technologies such as Augmented Reality and Artificial Intelligence to push the boundaries of innovation and shape the future of digitalization.
Our team of more than 1,500 employees spans different continents, cultures and disciplines. With our inclusive values, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive.
Become part of our winning team and help us create a world that works better.

The Strategic Account Executive will work as an integral part of the Strategic sales team responsible for identifying, building and maintaining sustainable partnerships, driving revenue and pipeline. This role will join a team that connects with C-level decision makers at enterprise companies with 1,000+ employees. You will hunt for new business, own the sales process from start to finish, and own and develop your own territory. TeamViewer team members are bright, self-motivated people who push boundaries in their pursuit of excellence. They are supported by a culture that encourages people to come up with innovative ideas to revolutionize IT and the digital world.

Main Responsibilities

· Develop innovative strategies and plans for each target and win new customers to grow the overall value of the territory.

· Engage at multiple levels within each customer account (eg CIO, CISO, CFO and CEO) to maximize account engagement and long-term success.

· Build a network of executive relationships across industry, community, business groups, and with key partners and customers to identify opportunities to increase sales.

· Monitor and take the necessary measures to ensure that you develop an adequate pipeline of opportunities via demand generation for consistent growth within your target accounts.

· Stay current and informed on all new campaigns, understanding their objectives and relevance, communicating to your sales team, and ensuring that all involved know their roles in the successful campaign.

· Manage existing customers for upsell and cross sell expansion.

· Build pipeline and forecast management, outbound lead generation.

Requirements

· 7+ of selling high value complex enterprise software solutions into a host of different verticals such as Insurance, Retail Banking and Finance.

· Have met/exceeded direct sales goals of 1M+ and operated with an average deal size of $150k+

· Familiarity with the MEDDPICC approach.

· Excellent track record of success in an individual contributor role with a strong net new business component and demonstrable success in growing footprints in existing customer.

· Ability to develop a strategic territory plan and create a relevant execution plan to deliver it

· Ability to clearly demonstrate comfort with senior level meetings and presentations in a virtual selling role.

· An ambitious self-starter with high energy and motivation.

· Demonstrated ability to grow deals through Consultative selling and Value-based approach

· Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of company data in accordance with established security policies.

· Report any suspected security incidents or breaches to the security team immediately.

· Ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory data privacy requirements in all aspects of work.

Up to 35% travel requirement

Additional Information

  • Our teams collaborate and work with each other towards a common goal.
  • We truly live and celebrate our cultural diversity: our colleagues come from more than 70 countries and speak more than 40 languages.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we’re focused on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best. TeamViewer will not discriminate against an individual based on race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis. title: Analista Financeiro
description:
O Analista Financeiro é responsável pela gestão eficiente das contas da empresa, garantindo a pontualidade no pagamento dos fornecedores e recebimento dos contratos vigentes com fornecedores referenciados, além de contribuir para a saúde financeira da rede de supermercados. Este profissional deve atuar com rigor nos processos financeiros, buscando sempre a precisão nas conciliações, a otimização do fluxo de caixa e o cumprimento das obrigações financeiras. Presencial – Riocentro
Buscamos profissionais com alta flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para interagir diretamente com a diretoria e a presidência, atuando em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante transformação, como exige o varejo.
Valorizamos perfis com grande capacidade de adaptação ao setor de varejo alimentar, que saibam responder rapidamente às mudanças e desafios do mercado.
Procuramos um profissional resiliente, com visão estratégica e preparado para se ajustar às novas direções do negócio, sempre alinhado aos objetivosdaempresa.
Requisitos: Formação superior em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia em contas a pagar e receber, preferencialmente no setor supermercadista. Conhecimento em ferramentas financeiras e sistemas ERP (preferencialmente Protheus, SAP, ou similares). Habilidade com Excel avançado para elaboração de relatórios e análises. Capacidade de negociação e comunicação clara com fornecedores e clientes. Proatividade, organização e atenção a detalhes. Facilidade para trabalhar sob pressão e cumprir prazos. Conhecimento em análise de crédito e cobrança.

Atividades

• Controlar o fluxo de contas a pagar, garantindo o pagamento de fornecedores dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

• Elaborar previsões de pagamento e fluxos de caixa a curto e médio prazo.

• Negociar prazos e condições de pagamento com fornecedores, buscando sempre as melhores condições para a empresa.

• Verificar e manter o controle de documentos fiscais (NF-es) e comprovantes de pagamento.

• Gerenciar o fluxo de contas a receber, sendo rigoroso na cobrança dos contatos vigentes.

• Emitir e controlar boletos e outras formas de recebimento.• Realizar a conciliação bancária e verificar o recebimento de valores nas contas da empresa.

• Identificar e solucionar pendências relacionadas a pagamentos e recebimentos.

• Realizar a atualização e controle de vencimentos de contas a receber.

• Emitir relatórios de inadimplência e acompanhar a negociação com clientes para recuperação de crédito.

Fluxo de Caixa e Relatórios:

• Acompanhar diariamente o fluxo de caixa da empresa, assegurando que todas as transações estejam devidamente registradas.

• Elaborar relatórios financeiros periódicos (diários, semanais, mensais) para análise da diretoria.

• Monitorar a posição de caixa e identificar desvios, propondo soluções quando necessário.

• Apoiar na elaboração do orçamento anual, projetando receitas e despesas conforme o histórico de vendas e pagamentos.

Compliance e Conciliação:

• Assegurar o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais, tributárias e contábeis relacionadas a contas a pagar e receber.

• Realizar a conciliação contábil das contas de fornecedores e clientes.

• Manter o controle de documentos financeiros, garantindo que estejam arquivados de acordo com as normas fiscais e corporativas.

Salário a combinar, Plano saúde (Klini), Sodexo refeição 40,00, Vale transporte. Enviar currículo para:

  • Empresa: Fredy Explica Consultoria em Psicologia Ltda
  • Endereço: Rua Afonso Cavalcanti,Cidade Nova- Rio de Janeiro / RJ

title: Operations Specialist
description:
Overview

Help build cutting-edge technology that saves lives!

Areti Health is a fast-growing Silicon Valley healthcare technology startup that dramatically boosts clinical trial patient recruitment using generative AI. Backed by leading venture capital firms, we are on a mission to transform clinical research through technology that allows pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies to bring their therapies to patients faster thereby saving lives.

We achieve unheard-of conversion rates, an up to 10x improvement over the human-driven process. Coupled with our seamless mass outreach capabilities, we compress recruitment timelines from many months to a few weeks across multiple therapeutic areas. Our AI Coordinator answers prospective patient questions based on the clinical trial documentation, schedules appointments, collects patient information, runs pre-qualification questionnaires, and assists with patient onboarding. We are already working with many of the largest US clinical research site networks. We are also an official partner of CRIO, a top-2 US clinical trial management system.

We offer a competitive salary, paid holidays and vacation, and the opportunity to work with a talented and dedicated team on cutting-edge generative AI applications.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Configure and maintain complex JSON configurations for trial recruitment workflows
  • Set up and manage Zapier integrations, particularly with Meta advertising platform
  • Provide customers with implementation guidance
  • Troubleshoot customer issues, identify gaps, and coordinate solutions with the engineering team
  • Monitor and optimize recruitment funnel performance
  • Document processes and maintain operational procedures
  • Act as a quality gatekeeper for all customer-facing elements during setup

Requirements :

  • 1–2 years of experience with JSON, Zapier, and Meta Business platform
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to follow procedures and maintain structured documentation
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Comfortable switching between multiple tools, systems, and priorities
  • Experience with calling API’s with tools such as Postman
  • Self-motivated, organized, and proactive

Nice to Have :

  • Experience working with customer onboarding or implementation teams
  • Familiarity with basic data validation or API responses (e.g., via browser dev tools or Postman)
  • Understanding of how data flows between systems (basic integration logic)
  • Experience using tools like Github, or Jira for task tracking
  • Use and set up of data analytics via Tableau, QuickSight, Power BI tools

Why You’ll Love This Role :

  • Your work directly impacts customer satisfaction and product success.
  • You’ll collaborate across departments and play a vital role in launch operations.
  • Opportunity to grow

title: Especialista em Implementação e Suporte de ON!Track
description:
O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com perfil comercial, excelente capacidade de comunicação e apresentação, que tenha facilidade para redesenhar processos operacionais dos clientes, identificar gaps e implementar melhorias usando as soluções digitais da Hilti, especialmente o ON!Track (solução digital que ajuda empresas a gerenciar ferramentas, equipamentos e ativos em tempo real). Este papel é essencial para garantir uma experiência de cliente excepcional e sustentável, atuando em parceria com os times de vendas e marketing locais e regionais.

Em que se consiste o trabalho?

Você será responsável por liderar a implementação dos nossos serviços digitais, com foco em:
  • Treinamento de clientes e melhoria de processos operacionais.
  • Compreensão profunda dos fluxos de trabalho dos clientes para aumentar a produtividade com as soluções Hilti.
  • Coordenação com os times de vendas e marketing locais e regionais para garantir colaboração e inovação.
  • Apoio ao lançamento e adoção de novas funcionalidades dos serviços.
  • Atuação prática e estratégica junto aos clientes, com visitas frequentes e engajamento direto.
  • Este papel exige mobilidade frequente em todo o Brasil,de 2 a 3 semanas por mês (de segunda a sexta-feira).

Isto é o que você precisará:

  • Formação superior completa (não é necessário curso específico).
  • Experiência comercial com foco em relacionamento com clientes.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, apresentação e engajamento.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e pensar de forma operacional.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • Inglês intermediário (desejável).

Por que vale a pena enviar sua candidatura?

Nossos funcionários compartilham um estilo muito próprio de ser. São determinados e dedicados, dando sempre o melhor si para exceder as expectativas dos nossos clientes. Em contrapartida, usufruem de carreiras incrivelmente dinâmicas e diversificadas. 93% dos nossos colaboradores dizem estar orgulhosos em trabalhar para a Hilti, graças à qualidade dos nossos produtos e a forma como cuidamos dos nossos colaboradores.

O que oferecemos?

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Vale alimentação/refeição
  • PPR – Plano de Participação nos Resultados
  • Totalpass (convênio com academias)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • EAP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal (Psicológica, Jurídica, Financeira e Social)
  • Niverday – 1 dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário
  • Auxílio Educacional
  • Premiação por tempo de serviço
  • Cultura de cuidado: gifts em datas especiais
  • Convênio com SESC/SENAC
  • Modelo de trabalho flexível
  • Descontos em produtos

title: Territory Manager Americas
description:
Mixscience recrute un (une) Territory Manager Americas à Brazil pour un contrat permanent.

Acteur majeur de la nutrition animale en France et à l'international, Mixscience s'adresse aux fabricants d'aliments, aux intégrateurs et aux distributeurs pour contribuer au développement de filières d'élevage durables. Avec 500 collaborateurs, l'entreprise développe et commercialise une gamme de produits comprenant prémix, minéraux, spécialités innovantes et solutions de biocontrôle adaptées à différentes espèces.

Ce poste peut être basé en zone LATAM, pas obligatoirement au Brésil. Vous intégrerez l'équipe commerciale internationale et contribuerez au développement de notre présence en Amérique Latine et aux États-Unis. En tant que Territory Manager, vous définirez et mettrez en œuvre la stratégie commerciale, serez ambassadeur de Mixscience dans la zone, et gérerez la promotion des produits, les opérations commerciales, et la représentation de la marque.

Vos principales missions incluront :

  • Identifier les opportunités B2B, sélectionner les distributeurs, et élaborer un plan de développement des ventes localement adapté.
  • Assurer la prospection, le suivi clients, la promotion des solutions Mixscience, en veillant à leur conformité réglementaire.
  • Animer un réseau de partenaires, gérer commandes, facturation, litiges, appels d'offres, recouvrement, et fixer les conditions tarifaires en lien avec la direction.
  • Effectuer une veille concurrentielle et coordonner efficacement avec les équipes internes.
  • Reporter régulièrement l'activité à la direction.
  • Encadrer et accompagner les Account Managers de la zone, veiller à l'exécution de la stratégie commerciale, au développement des compétences, et à l'autonomie des collaborateurs.

Profil recherché :

  • Formation supérieure en commerce international, agronomie ou domaine connexe.
  • Expérience confirmée en développement commercial international, connaissance des marchés LATAM et USA, secteur de la nutrition animale ou agroalimentaire serait un atout.
  • Expérience en environnement B2B exigeant, capacité à structurer une approche marché, développer un portefeuille clients, et construire des partenariats durables.
  • Leadership avéré, expérience en management, autonomie, rigueur, analyse, prise de décision en environnement évolutif.
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'espagnol indispensable, aisance relationnelle, forte capacité d’adaptation multiculturelle.

Intéressé(e) ? Faites-nous parvenir votre CV et nous vous contacterons pour un premier échange. Si votre profil correspond, un entretien avec votre futur manager et RH suivra. Nous serons ravis de vous accueillir dans l'équipe !

Mixscience est une filiale d’Avril, leader dans la filière des huiles et protéines végétales, présent dans l’alimentation, la nutrition animale, les énergies renouvelables, avec un chiffre d'affaires de 8 milliards d'euros en 2023 dans 19 pays. Travailler chez Avril, c'est choisir une entreprise engagée pour la performance responsable, l'innovation, et la croissance durable. Plus d’informations sur avril.com .

description:

Transformar a vida das pessoas através de inovação e tecnologia , este é o nosso propósito. Estamos procurando um(a) Cientista de Dados, que queira impulsionar a inovação conosco!
Somos um Instituto de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento formado por um time de pessoas incríveis,com ideias inovadoras, possuímos um ambiente descontraído e muito espírito colaborativo.
Promovemos em nosso dia-a-dia um ambiente de desenvolvimento , onde os Atlantes são o nosso maior foco, por isso um dos nossos valores mais fortes é a “Valorização de Pessoas” . Não é à toa, que estamos entre as melhores empresas de TI para se trabalhar no Brasil, segundo o ranking do GPTW.
Formação Acadêmica:

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia ou área relacionada.
  • Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado é desejável.
Responsabilidades:
  • Colaborar com clientes para entender seus desafios de negócios e identificar oportunidades para aplicar técnicas de ciência de dados.
  • Realizar análise exploratória de dados para identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Desenvolver, treinar e validar uma ampla gama de modelos de aprendizado de máquina para resolver problemas de negócios essenciais.
  • Aplicar técnicas de Visão Computacional (CV) para extrair insights estruturados de ativos de dados visuais.
  • Utilizar Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP) e Large Language Models (LLMs) para analisar texto não estruturado e aprimorar as capacidades do aplicativo.
  • Avaliar e otimizar o desempenho de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, usando métricas relevantes e técnicas de validação cruzada.
  • Comunicar os resultados de análises e modelos de forma clara e concisa para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Trabalhar em projetos de ciência de dados desde a concepção até a implementação e monitoramento dos resultados.
  • Explorar e implementar abordagens inovadoras para estender as capacidades do produto, potencialmente incorporando LLMs/CV para tarefas como legenda de imagens, questionamento visual e análise de dados multimodais.
  • Apresentar insights e recomendações baseados em dados para stakeholders em todos os níveis, tanto técnicos quanto não técnicos, de forma clara e concisa.
Requisitos obrigatórios:
  • Experiência comprovada na entrega de soluções de ciência de dados e aprendizado de máquina completas (end-to-end), desde a definição do problema até a implantação e o monitoramento.
  • Experiência com Python e bibliotecas populares para análise de dados e aprendizado de máquina (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.).
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística e técnicas de aprendizado de máquina (regressão, classificação, clustering, etc.).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (Tableau Desktop/Server, matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e SQL.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git).
  • Experiência com plataformas de computação em nuvem (AWS ou GCP).
  • Experiência no uso de ferramentas de processamento distribuído (por exemplo, Spark, Dask) para análise de dados em larga escala, engenharia de recursos e treinamento de modelos.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps para automatizar o ciclo de vida do modelo de aprendizado de máquina.
  • Experiência com técnicas de Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP) e Large Language Models (LLMs).
Idioma:
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita, conversação, técnico) para contato diário com parceiros no exterior.
Desejável:
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de visão computacional, incluindo segmentação de imagem e segmentação de instância.
  • Conhecimento de modelos de aprendizado profundo, incluindo redes neurais convolucionais (CNNs) e transformers.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de otimização matemática (por exemplo, gradiente descendente, otimização convexa, programação linear) para treinamento de modelos e ajuste de hiperparâmetros.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de experimentação (testes A/B).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas para monitorar modelos em produção.
  • Conhecimento de princípios e melhores práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo padrões de design (por exemplo, MVC, MVVM) e controle de versão.
Vem ser Atlante!!!
DIVERSIDADE E INCLUSÃO:
No Atlântico, a diversidade e a inclusão são compromissos inegociáveis. Como instituto dedicado à pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação, valorizamos e incentivamos a pluralidade de pensamentos e vivências, pois isso faz parte do nosso DNA. Nossa missão é promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diverso, buscando a equidade de oportunidades e o respeito à diversidade cultural, religiosa, étnico-racial, de gênero, de orientação afetivo-sexual e de pessoas com deficiência, voltado para a defesa e valorização dos direitos humanos. Atualmente, o Atlântico possui uma subárea dedicada à diversidade e inclusão, inserida na área de Pessoas & Cultura. Essa subárea trabalha em colaboração com o Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão e com os grupos de afinidades, que são compostos por pessoas voluntárias e têm como propósito oferecer um espaço seguro para a troca de vivências, a representatividade e a construção de ações afirmativas.
IMPACTO SOCIAL:
O Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão do Atlântico investe em ações de voluntariado com foco no impacto social positivo por meio do Grupo de Afinidade de Justiça Social. Nós nos concentramos em apoiar organizações do terceiro setor e projetos de impacto social que trabalhem com os públicos que são contemplados pelos pilares do Atlântico. Em 2022, lançamos nosso primeiro projeto voltado para a capacitação de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social. O projeto-piloto foi realizado na Comunidade de Ancuri, em parceria com a organização Visão Mundial e a ONG Associação Santos Dias, e formou 40 jovens em Lógica de Programação Básica.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Solutions Architect for Automotive to help our partners (companies like Mercedes, Ford, GM, Elektrobit, Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) and prospects understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.
Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to embedded. And we continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
Beyond an expected Automotive expertise, this career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also dedicated team players that take pride in team and company wins.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.
Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • Engage customers during presales to gather requirements and explain our technology
  • Liaise with other Canonical's experts (mastering the Cloud, Kubernetes, Security or Safety, etc) to aggregate our collective knowledge into comprehensive solutions for our prospective clients
  • Participate to the delivery of select projects related to Embedded Linux, including demos and PoCs
  • Convey market requirements to key stakeholders in our organization, and sometimes participate to the development or refining of generic solutions to unlock market potential
  • Be both a customer advocate and a trusted advisor to Canonical
If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies applied to Automotive, if you want to play an active role in building Software Defined Vehicles, if you are curious with a will to learn how to leverage and adapt Cloud technologies to the embedded world, you will love working at Canonical.
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Solid embedded Linux experience - Yocto or RTOS
  • Fluency in Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Professional written and spoken English in addition to the local language
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Result-oriented, ability to multi-task
  • A personal drive to meet commitments
  • An humble learner and quick study
  • Relevant experience in the Automotive industry
  • Albeit many projects can be done remotely, the successful candidate will be willing to travel up to 30% of the time for customer meetings, company events, and conferences
Additional skills that you might also bring (but not mandatory)
  • Experience with ISO26262 and/or ISO21434
  • Experience with customer engagements
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.
